generation.explanation: For a normal distribution, about 68% of the data falls within 1 standard deviation (σ) of the mean μ, about 95% within 2σ, and about 99.7% within 3σ. The animation shades these three nested bands one at a time and labels the percentage in each slice. The two slices just outside ±1σ hold about 13.6% each, and the slices between 2σ and 3σ hold about 2.1% each. Afterward, drag the slider to pick any number of standard deviations k and see the exact share of data within μ ± kσ.
